name: marketing-psychology
description: Evidence grades and consumer-protection rule checks for the psychology in your marketing. Grade a claim such as 'losses hurt twice as much' against the original studies and their replications. Audit a page, email or paywall for the levers it uses: each one is quoted, graded and paired with the fact that makes it legitimate. Check countdowns, stock badges, reviews, 'was' prices, trials and cancellation paths against dated US, EU and UK rules. Read price tiers for anchors and decoys with the arithmetic shown. Diagnose why a target behaviour does not happen with COM-B. Never invents proof, studies or a promised lift.

interface.longDescription: Five skills that put evidence and dated rules next to the psychology in your marketing. Dark-pattern check takes a flow or element (countdown, stock or activity badge, reviews, was/now price, fees, pre-ticked extras, trial and renewal, cancel path, consent banner, streak rewards) and returns a register table: the fact each element depends on, the US, EU and UK rules it may engage with the date each was last read, severity as risk triage, a subscribe-versus-cancel count and an honest version. Persuasion audit reads a page, email, paywall or onboarding screen and lists every lever it pulls, quoted, with its evidence grade, the fact that makes it legitimate, any rule it touches and a keep, fix or remove verdict, plus a proof inventory with steps to collect real proof. Price framing normalises tiers, shows annual savings and per-day figures with formulas, and runs a decoy test that treats price as an attribute. Evidence check grades claims such as 'losses hurt twice as much' from A to D against replications and meta-analyses, citing only a checked ledger. Behavior diagnosis maps why a target behavior does not happen with COM-B, intervals on step rates and friction-first changes. It never writes fake proof, never predicts a lift and is not legal advice; rules read more than six months ago are flagged for re-checking.
defaultPrompt: Our banner says 'Was $120, now $79, ends tonight' and resets daily. Is that a dark pattern in the EU and US?
Audit our signup page: hero 'Save 10 hours a week', 3 client logos, 'Only 2 spots left!' timer. Keep, fix or remove?
Tiers $29/$79/$199 a month, 3/10/unlimited seats, Pro annual $790. Check anchors, decoy and discount framing with the math.
